Review against `AI/KNOWLEDGE_RULES.md` and the central register `docs/TONG_HOP_KIEN_THUC_VA_MO_RONG_BAO_CAO.md`. Generate real sequential CHK IDs; these items review requirements quality, not execution completion.

- [ ] CHK[NNN] Do requirements identify knowledge/function/output changes and require a same-change central register update?

- [ ] CHK[NNN] Are artifact paths, reproduction, status/evidence and limitations required, with planned outputs distinguished from existing ones?
- [ ] CHK[NNN] Are register-update and verification tasks required before affected work is documentation-complete, with reasoned no-impact handling?
